coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: The output matches 2 of the 7 ground-truth variable items (29%): the two baseline prompts and per-task accuracy comparisons between optimized and baseline instructions. The latter match is incomplete because the expected improvement threshold is omitted.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design uses 27 BBH tasks instead of 23, omits the 20% optimization/80% testing split, and evaluates a fixed instruction rather than optimizing from an empty instruction. It does not specify the required PaLM 2-L-IT optimizer/text-bison scorer pairing or measure final training accuracy. Although it compares per-task accuracy, it does not specify >5% improvement in at least 19 or 20 of 23 tasks.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: The output omits the conclusion that OPRO-optimized instructions outperform the baselines by over 5% on the majority of tasks.
